title: 6 individuals booked in Jefferson, Alabama facilities on June 6
text:
Six people were processed at different facilities in Jefferson, Alabama, on June 6, 2026, with bookings reported at three separate locations.
Two charges each appeared in the ‘Traffic’ and ‘Warrant’ categories, and the ‘Public Order’ and ‘Domestic’ categories each appeared once among the listed offenses.
Charges reflected in booking records correspond to the time of booking. These individuals have not been found guilty of any offense cited in this record.
